youtube.title: Ben Franklin roasted the bald eagle. He wanted the turkey 🦃 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Benjamin Franklin called the bald eagle a bird of "bad moral character." 🦅

His pick? The turkey.

Team Eagle or Team Turkey? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in a 1784 letter to his daughter, Franklin complained the eagle on the Society of the Cincinnati badge "does not get his living honestly" (it steals fish from other birds), gets chased off by a bird no bigger than a sparrow, and called the turkey "a much more respectable bird" and "a bird of courage."
